metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · Latin Blood: The Ballad of Ney Matogrosso
metas.description: From a repressive childhood to artistic revolution, Ney Matogrosso transforms Brazil's stages - and himself - through music, creativity and inner fire.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers: Our Brother, Hillel
metas.description: Gritty, formative years of the Los Angeles band, and the influence of original guitarist Hillel Slovak, who died in 1988. It features interviews with bandmates Flea and Anthony Kiedis who discuss the band's early evolution.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · 10 Dance
metas.description: Two expert dancers, Shinya Sugiki and Shinya Suzuki, aim to master each other's styles for a prestigious competition, but old rivalries and potential romance complicate their partnership.
